text: That afternoon: Holmes says he thinks there was probably some more tangible cause
why: In ¶194 Holmes says he thinks there was probably some more tangible cause; the visit takes place in the afternoon, as arranged and greeted with 'Good-afternoon' in ¶125.

text: That afternoon: Holmes says they must leave, bids Miss Stoner good-bye and tells her to be brave
why: ¶194 has Holmes saying they must leave, saying good-bye and telling her to be brave, during the same afternoon visit.

text: How did Julia die? — Holmes does not think that she died from sudden fright
why: Asked whether Julia died from some sudden fright, Holmes answers 'No, I do not think so' in ¶193-194.
